verdict.rationale: 2FAS's live machine-readable pricing file states that 2FAS Auth ships with 'no telemetry', so there is no usage tracking to opt out of for the authenticator. However, this is a single line in a pricing file, and it covers only 2FAS Auth. For 2FAS Pass, the evidence shows only no-registration anonymous use, which is not a statement about telemetry. missing for 10: a dedicated privacy or telemetry policy doc, an explicit no-telemetry statement or opt-out control for 2FAS Pass and the browser extensions, independent or hands-on verification that no tracking occurs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: no tiers, no premium, no in-app purchases, no advertising, no telemetry.
